_meta.title: ExamLeaf learning-psychology design tokens (derived from ChatGPT message 04)
_meta.status: Proposed design specifications, not neuroscientific optima. Timing/pacing/interaction values are production hypotheses (source: 'starting ranges', 'proposed defaults', 'design hypothesis'). Validate with students on real phones.
_meta.units: px for type sizes on a 1920x1080 master; ms for animation timing; seconds for pauses; wpm for narration
_meta.this_file_is: A convenience extraction. The canonical design tokens remain the planning-pack file named in canonical_design_tokens_path.
_meta.organiser_computed_fields: Any field whose key contains 'organiser' or whose note says 'organiser' was computed by the organiser and is NOT stated in the source.

light.contrast_method: relative luminance (WCAG); each colour against the background only, not every pair of accents

dark.accent_colours: Not specified in the source. Canonical design_tokens.json: 'Other accents require separate contrast validation before dark-mode use.'

organiser_light_accents_on_dark_backgrou.note: organiser-computed; all below 4.5:1, so light-theme accents cannot be reused unchanged as dark-theme text

dark.claim_boundary: Do not claim dark mode universally reduces fatigue; offer and test a dark variant where appropriate.

wcag_thresholds.note: Starting requirements, not a substitute for testing actual video frames.

color_use_rules: Keep identity stable: a quantity does not change colour because the scene changed.
Limit emphasis: one dominant highlight at a time.
Do not rely on colour alone: distinguish graph lines with labels, line patterns or shapes.
Respect scientific conventions: a red oxygen atom is not an error indicator.
Check adjacent colours: two colours that each contrast with the background may be hard to tell apart.
Use a pale highlight area with dark text rather than a large block of saturated colour behind a long explanation.

starting_specification_source_msg04.typeface: A clear family such as Inter or an appropriate Noto Sans script family
starting_specification_source_msg04.weight: Medium or semibold for essential labels; avoid very thin strokes
starting_specification_source_msg04.layout: Split, enlarge, or zoom before shrinking essential information
starting_specification_source_msg04.label: pilot targets, not accessibility rules mandating a particular font size

typography.captions: Accurate selectable captions, an accessible transcript and a protected caption area; avoid full-paragraph narration + animated diagram + equation + moving karaoke captions at once.

animation.label: production hypotheses (untested starting values)
animation.motion_budget_note: Untested starting budget for first ordinary 2D revision pilots; count substantial changes in the explanatory model, not caption updates or a moving cursor; do not require animation just to meet the percentage.
change_types: semantic (arrow appears, variable changes, step added)

timing_defaults.completed_diagram_inspection: Determined by its labels and required task, not a fixed limit

animation.physical_simulation_rule: Never change a physical simulation's behaviour merely to satisfy an animation timing rule.

interaction.label: design hypothesis
interaction.player_control: Learner-controlled 'Continue to explanation' action; no automatic answer reveal after a stressful countdown.
interaction.video_label: 10-minute revision video, with optional practice pauses

narration.label: starting points for English-language pilots; validate other languages separately
narration.playback_speed_note: Accelerated-playback evidence (small costs at 1.5x and 2x, poorer above 2x) used lecture material at ~157 and ~166 wpm; not generalisable to unfamiliar equations, second-language narration or dense Biology.

spacing_schedule_hypothesis.practice: A changed numerical or diagram question
Another delayed check and targeted repair

evaluation_parameters.primary_outcome: Performance on a delayed, unprompted assessment containing unfamiliar but curriculum-aligned applications

illustrative_sample_size.note: approximate planning calculations, not a power analysis; before attrition
